 Advertisement Police investigating active shooter incident at Solano Town Center in Fairfield
 Advertisement Updated: 10:09 PM PDT Oct 30, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jeremiah Martinez Digital Producer Police investigating active shooter incident at Solano Town Center in Fairfield
 Updated: 10:09 PM PDT Oct 30, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jeremiah Martinez Digital Producer FAIRFIELD, Calif. — Officers are at the scene of an active shooter incident at the Solano Town Center in Fairfield, police said. 
 Suisun City police said they are assisting Fairfield police by providing mutual aid and officers are searching for a suspect. 
 Advertisement California Highway Patrol said it is assisting police with traffic control and clearing buildings.
 A lot of the officers appear to be focusing their attention on the Spirit of Halloween store, KCRA 3’s Denzen Cortez reported.
 Fairfield police are expected to address the media at 11:30 p.m.
 This is a developing story. Stay with KCRA 3 for the latest.
